signs.Aries: Something could bring you much closer to someone special. The chance to talk will reveal exciting interests that you both shares, and also pave the way for new developments in the future. If you have any issues that you need to discuss, then it is best to get these out of the way first, to ensure a smooth journey ahead.
signs.Taurus: Conversation is important in making the right kind of decisions concerning your love life. There may be some conflict between wanting to have your own way, and demanding certain rights within your current relationship, or withholding certain information in order to maintain a degree of control over your partner (current or prospective). It is best to communicate from your heart rather than your head.
signs.Gemini: Be prepared for some spirited conversation between you and someone you have set your heart upon. Bartering is not quite the right word, and yet there is a sense in which you are both battling verbally to make sure that you both get what you know you deserve. But at least you are both being honest with each other - up to a point!
signs.Cancer: You may find yourself strangely reticent in conversations with loved ones. You may have the feeling that you cannot quite trust your partner (current or prospective) to respond to something you have to say in a positive and open manner. This will not really help the situation, and it would be better if you could be honest - if not with them, then at least with yourself.
signs.Leo: You will have the opportunity to hold that conversation with a loved one that you have been meaning to have for some time. Although you may have to cover an area of difficulty between you, both of you realize that it is essential this be discussed now, before further misunderstandings arise. Making the first move is the most difficult part of the whole process.
signs.Virgo: Although you may know in your heart of hearts that you are right, it is still worth holding that conversation, and making sure that your partner (current or prospective) understands the situation. You both desire to communicate at a deeper level than mere words can hope to achieve. Although you may not see eye-to-eye, you can at least accept each other as you are.
signs.Libra: You are likely to be far more secretive than is necessary about a certain event, which could affect the relationship between you and a loved one. Conversation is imperative. It is essential that you both get the right perspective on the situation so as to dissolve any further fears or tensions. It is only a short step to a greater understanding between you both.
signs.Scorpio: Talking is necessary today in order to increase real communication in your current relationship, but it has to be the right kind of talking. There is no use in glossing over difficult details in order to make life easier. You both need to address the essential problem. That will require more than a little courage but will be very worthwhile in the long run.
signs.Sagittarius: Today you will have the ability to access some of your deeper feelings so that you can talk to a loved one about how you really feel. You may be justified in your anger but focusing on those negative feelings will only make matters worse. If you can discuss your issues with openness and honesty you will find a new love developing that will bring with it some real healing.
signs.Capricorn: All conversations are made up of words, and yet there is a subtle difference between genuine and superficial exchanges that needs acknowledging.  You can discover more about how you communicate with the person closest to you. Allow yourself to say what you are feeling, and don't pretend otherwise. Learning to speak from the depths of your heart will take you into miraculous new territory.
signs.Aquarius: Today you will have the chance to have that conversation with someone whom you have been dying to talk to for some time. But there is no point in rushing straight in with all those questions that you don't seem to be at all embarrassed to ask. You will just scare them off. If you really care for this person, give some consideration to their feelings.
signs.Pisces: You love to converse with others, but today, one conversation in particular contains a real sense of magic. It is also the key to developing a more fruitful and intimate relationship with someone whom you hold particularly dear. You will find yourself focusing on exploring your feelings, and to be honest expressing them. If you can be authentic, you have much to look forward to.
